senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. art.) [that which runs through cracks,] resin, balsam (v.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:11">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, quot. s. v. <cite ref="B00894"><he>בַּלְסָם</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Keritot 6a">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הצ׳</he> an ingredient of frankincense.

<cite ref="Shabbat 25b">Sabb. 25ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite> <he>אין מדליקין בצ׳</he> you must not feed the Sabbath lamp with balsam; Y. ib. II, 4ᵈ <he>אין מדליקין צוֹרִי</he>.
